startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: List of urls to process. Accepts a JSON array, a single string, or a comma/newline separated list.

urls.title: URLs (alias of startUrls)
urls.description: Alias of 'startUrls' for compatibility with tools that use this field name.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Total pages to crawl across every start URL combined. Clamped to 1-50.

maxDepth.title: Max link depth
maxDepth.description: How many link-hops from each start URL to follow. 0 audits only the start URLs themselves. Clamped to 0-5.

followExternalLinks.title: Follow external links
followExternalLinks.description: When true, links to a different domain than the start URL are also crawled (still counted against maxPages/maxDepth). When false (default), off-site links are still checked for brokenLinks but not crawled as their own pages.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for each page or link check before giving up. Clamped to 3-60.
